help.title: Help & FAQ
help.description: Accounts, languages, following articles, and contributing.
help.contactPrompt: Contact the Juza team with your question.

faqs.a: Juza is a civic information platform for Rwanda and East Africa. It explains rights, rules, and public services in plain language — in English, French, and Kinyarwanda.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to read articles?
faqs.a: No. Anyone can browse and search. An account lets you bookmark, follow articles, report problems, and apply to contribute.

faqs.q: How do I change the language?
faqs.a: Use EN | FR | RW in the header. At signup you also choose a preferred language as your default.
You get an in-app alert when that article is published or updated. Open the bell in the header to read alerts.

faqs.q: How do I become a contributor?
faqs.a: Sign in, open your dashboard, and submit a contributor request. An admin reviews it. Contributors draft articles; admins approve what goes live.

faqs.q: How do I report a mistake?
faqs.a: Open the article and use Report. Admins can reply on the same thread.

faqs.q: How do I contact Juza and get a reply?
faqs.a: Use Contact or Help. If you’re signed in, replies appear under Dashboard → My messages and in the notification bell. Guests should check email.

faqs.q: I forgot my password. What now?
faqs.a: On the login page, choose Forgot password, enter your email, open the reset link, then set a new password.

about.title: About Juza
about.description: Clear civic knowledge for Rwanda and East Africa.
body: Juza explains rules, rights, and public services in plain language — in English, French, and Kinyarwanda.
Citizens can read and bookmark articles. Contributors write reviewed content. Admins keep the library accurate.
Our goal is simple: everyone should understand how their country works.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Send a message to the Juza team.
body: Use this form for partnerships, questions, or feedback.
To report an article error, use the report button on that article.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: We collect only what we need to run your account: name, email, and the bookmarks or drafts you create.
We do not sell personal data. Session information is used to keep you signed in and to protect the platform.
You can request account deletion by contacting us. Demo mode stores data only in your browser.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: A short agreement for using Juza.
body: Juza provides civic information for learning and everyday decisions. It is not a substitute for official legal advice.
Contributors agree to submit accurate information and respect the review process before publishing.
Misuse of the platform — including spam, harassment, or deliberate misinformation — may lead to account suspension.
